claim_boundary: This artifact couples coefficient bounds, stationary support, scale windows, and cross-gcd sums to bound all registered smooth strong near-double cores by the arithmetic factor X^(13/30+o(1)) after the common chart factor. Weak, simple-root, nonsmooth, moment, density, and interval branches remain open.

correction_resolution.statement: Cycle 113's anchor-scale warning is resolved by using B,C<=Q jointly with n',m~Q; Cycle 112's X3/5 route is superseded by the X13/30 coupled route

coupled_theorem.aggregate: all degrees at one strong mode cost Q^(-1/2)*X^o(1); summing |w|<=2M gives M*Q^(-1/2)*X^o(1)=X^(13/30+o(1)) after the common analytic chart factor
coupled_theorem.anchor_bound: B=p0*n'<=Q and C=q0*m<=Q with n',m>=aQ imply p0,q0<=1/a
coupled_theorem.boundary: weak localization, simple roots, nonsmooth payload variants, full moment assembly, density, and intervals remain open
coupled_theorem.coefficient_comparability: simultaneous support and a small near-hit make K,B0,C0 comparable to Zc=Q/lambda
coupled_theorem.gcd_bound: splitting at Z=min(N,R)<=d or >=d bounds the gcd sum by d*Z*(d*N*R)^o(1)
coupled_theorem.gcd_identity: sum_u gcd(u,R)gcd(d-u,N) expands with phi(a)phi(b) over a|R,b|N and at most 1+d/(ab) solutions
coupled_theorem.scale_window: a fixed core has O(Q/Zc) supported scales, each full coefficient kernel is O(Q^(-3/2)), so its scale sum is O(1/(sqrt(Q)*Zc))
coupled_theorem.split_reduction: support comparability forces u,v comparable to d and Zc comparable to d*Z/(x*y), reducing the split sum to sum gcd(u,R)gcd(d-u,N)/(d*Z*sqrt(Q))

remaining_target.statement: control weak localization and simple-root averages, then assemble the full signed moment
